commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

34' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Clermont, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
33' A yellow card is awarded to Julien Le Cardinal (Brest).
32' A cross from a corner kick by Clermont is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

32' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Bizot reacts superbly to deny him. Clermont have been awarded a corner kick.

26' Steve Mounie (Brest) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
25' The ball goes out for a corner. Brest can continue in their attacking effort.
25' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Mory Diaw easily deals with the threat.
24' Mahdi Camara (Brest) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

19' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Stephanie Frappart blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
16' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) trips an opposition player and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul.
15' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
14' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

9' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
7' Stephanie Frappart shows the yellow card to Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) for a heavy challenge.
6' Alan Virginius (Clermont) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
